sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: The Spanish version of resolution WHA71.7 on digital health opens with a preamble recalling earlier eHealth resolutions and recognizing the potential of digital technologies for the Sustainable Development Goals. It notes that human interaction remains key and highlights recent progress in national digital health strategies.

sections.title: Page 2

summary.text: Continues the Spanish text of WHA71.7, acknowledging countries' experience and urging Member States to assess and prioritize digital technologies for equitable access to health. Further requests cover integration into health systems, standards and interoperability.

sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: Continues the Spanish resolution with requests to Member States on public health resilience, rapid response, workforce capacity, digital literacy and data protection. It then begins the requests to the Director-General, including guidance on protecting and using health data.

sections.title: Page 4

summary.text: Ends the Spanish resolution with requests to the Director-General for a repository of evidence, monitoring of trends, UN collaboration and a progress report in 2020.
